findings.issue: `ICenter_self_pointSet_eq_I_add` ends in a dangling `_add` that never names the addend, so the name does not determine the statement; its sibling added in the same PR spells the same `+ n` as `_add_card`.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:108 `def Icount`, Basic.lean:280 `def JNumCount`, Basic.lean:286 `def JCount`; all three are in `namespace GridPoint` and all three are listed side by side in the Main definitions block at Basic.lean:32-37.
findings.fix: Pick one spelling for the family — `ICount`, `JNumCount`, `JCount` — and rename the `Icount*` declarations and their uses in `Center.lean` and `Count.lean` accordingly.
findings.issue: The new relation-parametric family spells the same suffix two ways: `Icount` (and its ~12 `Icount_*` lemmas) versus `JNumCount`/`JCount` (and their `JCount_*` lemmas). A consumer cannot guess which of `Icount`/`ICount` exists.

summary: New names are mostly descriptive and no notation is introduced, but one new lemma sits in a namespace whose type never appears in its statement, one name truncates its addend, and the new asymmetric pairing is documented as "symmetrized".
